title: The degree-sequence conjecture for non-trivial flow-critical tame canvases
statement:
Let $(\mathfrak{G},z)$ be a **non-trivial flow-critical tame canvas**, and let $C(\mathfrak{G},z)$ denote its associated degree sequence. If

$$
\deg(z)\geq 8
$$

and $\mathfrak{G}$ has a vertex of degree $\deg(z)-3$, then **the degree-sequence conjecture** says that

$$
C(\mathfrak{G},z)\in\bigl\{\{\deg(z)-3,5\},
\{\deg(z)-3,5,5,5\}\bigr\}.
$$

This removes the preceding corollary's assumption that a specified tip preflow exists. It is presented as a belief in the source, and no resolution is supplied.
source_name: Arnbjörg Soffía Árnadóttir, Zdeněk Dvořák, Bernard Lidický, Benjamin Moore, Evelyne Smith-Roberge and Robert Šámal, “Flow-critical graphs”, arXiv:2502.01451 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.01451

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2025).
